To check status we might use displayCarStatus with option "doors". But they want confirmation. So we call displayCarStatus with option "doors" to see status. Then reply. Then startEngine with ignitionMode "START".

We need to do stepwise: first display doors status. Then after confirming, start engine.

Thus we call displayCarStatus.
